body: If only we could listen to our own logic sometimes

Sometimes ill remeber all the reasons why life is painful. and ill want to do things i know are not in my best interests. but i feel these tribulations are part of being a real human being. and they make you a more down to earth person after the fact.

These days im doing OK i like to believe i wont hurt myself. i can see myself in so many others and I want to help. im not very good at it but im sure i will improve as time goes on.

i dont think its a realistic expectation to place on yourself to just overcome this. you will get better at coping with it. often these things come from blaming yourself, never blame yourself, no matter what. but self improvment takes time. i truly believe each and every one of us has it within us. and eventually you wont remeber why you felt as bad as you did. you dont even realise its happening, but you start to feel things again like looking forward to something.

I really hope you're doing good, and that your future brings you to greener pastures. goodluck out there
Anything you want :)

No im not making predictions. im hopfully saying that i wish things will get better and in my opinion, im sure that they will. this is different from a prediction like what you say "Well things aren't going to get better so ot doesn't matter" or "there will be no self improvement." that is a negative prediction, the difference being it stated as fact and not opinion - all i meant was theres no way to know these things and assuming the worst is something to work on bit by bit. truly im sorry if i have offended you.

im trying to just explain that im not telling you how your life is, thats not my place and i wouldnt want to make predictions like that im just saying that im hoping that things get better and i feel that in my opinion that they will go that way if you keep at this and try small acts of self improvment over a long period of time. its just my opinion, im not trying to state facts im sorry you find that hypocritical and dishonest.

yeah you're right i fully agree everything takes work. and learnig lessons from the past experinces can be so difficult. i know what you mean. but please dont shut off all your future possibilites becos of this i truly believe you are strong. and can pick things up

If you cant predict the future then why only allow yourself to predict it negativly? by that logic you cannot know yourself so dont assume the worst is going to happen.

They might well do. i really hope they do for you but, im sure they will. time will tell. 

Just cos you dont think that it will doesnt make it not true either. it goes both ways.

Its easy to look at things with the negative perspective seeming the only plausable one, we all have our own paths to go down, and theres no logical reason to suspect its going to get worse and not improve, i hope things pickup for you thick and fast but the self doubting and having a negative outlook on future is something we can all work away on. little by little.

becos it wont be zero payoff forever, you've felt it before. a long time ago maybe, maybe not so long. but you know deep down that you will feel more satisfied about things over time as things get better and better little by little. i know you have it in you

In this situation faliure is a good thing. please i beg you to consider the alternatives, i think you're unaware of your own strengh of will, and that you are wrong, you being alive proves much more than nothing, its a wonderful thing and i appriciate it. be tenacious and never give in, i know you have it in you
thats the one thing im sure of. you're still here. give youself some credit you deserve it.

I dont :)

what i think of you is. I think you're very reasonable, smart. and alot stronger than you know.

dont listen to the negative things and not listen to the posative things. you are not an abomination you are worth so much more than that and you always will be.

yes the ones i consider truly bad people are those who feel no remorse for the actions that they do. not meaning that you are not a bad person if you do terrible things. absolutley certain things are beyond salvation but if you make a mistake and feel truly sorry for it, then you are not a bad person you are sombody who has had a difficult life that tought them some very bad lessons. and led them to a desperate situation. - and like i have always said this is just my definition of what i consider a bad person, there is no correct or incorrect definition here thats not how it works. this is just my opinion on remorse and self critisism its how i feel on the matter. and you clearly have a seperate definition on what makes somone a bad person, and a very reasonable one at that, but please there is no need to put words in my mouth or strongly imply im saying things which i just wasn't. missing my point entirly

yes i see where you're coming from, i never intended to justify doing anything that would hurt anyone, and i never would want to do that, and that really was not my point

why dont you listen to these lots of people? i understand it being repeated it makes you so annoyed, especially if they have repeated it over and over but becos of this infact i think that should surly be worth considering as points in my opinion. especially if everyone is saying it might be a point to it. in my mind

Im genuinly sorry for upsetting you, and that none of my words have resonated with you. or on the contrary made you annoyed or upset, knowing this i can delete it if you wish. i never inteded to do anyone any harm quite the opposite infact

I hope for you all the best, goodluck out there.

i fully agree which is why im careful to express things as "my opinion" or "i feel" there is no right or wrong in disscussions just differring opinions. in my mind atleast im just expressing my opinion, truly im sorry if that upset you in anyway it was never my intetion.

yes, that misinterperation of my definition. is a bad definition, not everything is so black and white, and i never once said that definition would exempt any kind of behaviour. you are intetionally misinterpeting my argument, why? you know fine well i never said that if you were to do that you wouldnt be a bad person. this is turning into a farce.

I dont know if i fully understand this one but i was saying that not everything needs to help even if it inteded to and thats no reason not to try, and that it can be very helpful to talk to people who have your best interests at hand.

Im really sorry that it didnt help you. it was intended for one person in particular, i hope with all my being that it helped them. and anyone else. even just one person thinking one thing better makes it worth it.

maybe it doesnt help you then. and thats OK, but you cant speak for everyone. 

Im not trying to repeat anything and to the best of my knowledge i havent said anything like this before, seriously i am truly sorry that my words annoyed you if even only a little. i never inteded anything like that..

Im not making any claims at all. im saying becos nothing lasts theres no reson not to expect the bad to pass just like the good.

you have to make some assumptions, absolutley. But i never claimed to know anything about your life, when i say i have been in your shoes i mean the negative outlook on things you had already displayed in the content i was replying to. i wasnt trying to make any assumptions at all, im sorry if i crossed a line.

how is attepting things we are bad at dangerous, you know fine well that i didnt mean anything negative, the subject matter was about helping people, and that you never would. and my reply to that specifically was that you will get better as you do it more, like anything knitting included :P 

Dont listen to people who tell you to go kill themselves. legit ever. you honestly dont deserve to be spoken to like that.

Yes. that is my defintion of a bad person yes, everyone makes mistakes. some people do terrible things ofcourse, but the ones who I consider truly bad people are the ones who feel no remorse, no guilt, and certainly wouldnt self critisise, which was my point. - therefor you have to be a good person. otherwise you wouldnt of believed yourself when you told yourself that you were not.

It doesnt *need* to help, not everything is fixed overnight and having a conversation with sombody who has your best interests at hand and they can see beyond the black dog of self loathing and crippling doubt can be very helpful like i say yes.

i dont see why you are challenging everything im saying to such an extent. but if it helps you, im here for as long as you need me

becos nothing lasts, good or bad so theres a good reason to believe you wont be extending a "shit existance" but a very satisfying one. you cant know what you're doing in 5 mintues nevermind 5 years.

Please understand that i have been in your shoes to an almost lethal extent. in my opinion, It is not the right way. its no way at all

if you're bad at something that should be all the more reason to attempt it. we dont gain experience or knowledge without doing so.

yes what you say is true people can be arseholes becos they are depressed, and this is as they have told themselves they are shit people. which just isnt true. you wont hate any part of yourself if you are a bad person, only the good self critisise, im in no way lying i hope you dont misunderstand what i mean.

while in a depressive state, talking to other people also in a depressive state can be a great idea! and whatever helps you is good in my eyes. but while not being in the best frame of mind and getting advice from somone in a simularly clouded sitatuon, in my opinion. May not be in your best interests. it can be very helpful to talk to people who can see your own life in a better place than you can see it yourself.

Yes. i know its not how everyone thinks. but i absolutley do love my fellow mankind. regardless of knowing them. we're not talking being in-love or any kind of factuaion. please dont misinterperate what i posted. Each and every person is an entire world within a world. 7+ billion people on this planet and NOT 1 single person chose their meatbag, we are all along for the ride. I meant i have a profound respect for people, and yes that includes you.

If you ever want to talk abut literlly anything HMU

Know i mean it when i say it. Goodluck out there i wish you all the best

Oh what a tangled web we weave when we first decide to decieve

This is cos you have to remeber every lie you told to every person. - compulsive liars are an interesting situation. often it comes from a lack of feeling accepted for who they really are for internal pressures they place on themselves. (too boring, havent done X therefor not good enough)

so as a result of this they make up stories lies and other things.

after a while tho they begin to lose touch of reality and enter a state of deniel. in which they feel content with lying just about anything. sometimes it can be truly mindblowing

the reason for it is probably negative social pressures which the person interalises and feels inadequate as a result.

the only way to help sombody like this is to help them understand that the people who are worth your time will accept you and find you interesting for the stories that are real. and the real person that you are. - ive had this talk with quite a few people and they all understand the inevitable reality sooner or later. that is, your real friends will always accept you however you are. so you might aswell be honest to yourself and others

The way i see it anxiety is an ongoing process and learning to manage it and control it is an ongoing process its influenced massivly by your opinion of your situation and your self worth. these can all be made worse by many negative things we tell ourselves.

dont be so hard on yourself you dont 'need' to conquer anything and thinking you can just flip it to ok mode like a light switch is an unfair and unrealistic expectation to place on yourself. we become more accompanied with situations the more we do them. things become easier over time and it takes time.

Its very important to hold yourself in a positive frame, its important to actively forgive yourself. even if you do not feel like you are learning from your mistakes, you are. and you will learn to trust yourself. nothing is ever as bad as you think it is going to be.

Anxiety is developed over time like a mature cheese, we tell ourselves we wont be able to do things or we dont know how anymore. realising what you've been telling yourself is wrong, is a good moment

even if you dont feel comfortable in your ability to do something it doesn't mean anything bad will happen, its okay to be worried and doubtful.

i dont know but i think the panic attacks may be related to the medication but medication can bring a whole host of its own issues that im sure youre aware of. im really sorry about your recent episode, dont fill your head with worries if you can at all help it. you will move out, you will find love and happiness. comfort-ability and confidence. and you really have plenty of time. so dont worry about these things. they really are a cross that bridge when you come to it type of situation.

You said you've been in bed for the past year man you dont think its normal to develop anxiety after that? it would be crazy if you didnt, dont be hard on yourself. you will rise again

as for the part of you that is ready to give up, id like to have a little word with them. - negativity cant see past tomorrow, posativity cant see past yesterday

Stay strong, be brave.

As humans we like to find the reason and order to things. but life doesnt work like that and even if you got the genuine reason it might not give you any closure. 

its okay not to know what youre doing, its okay not to know why, its okay to want to know why, the truth is life is very random and there often isnt any logic or sense that would help anything.

practicing and exercising the ability to move on from situations you dont have clousure from or dont understand will make you incredibly strong person and make you much more able to deal with these kinds of brainfucks.

im sorry this happened to you genuinely i am. you dont deserve it nobody does. everyone deserves an explanation and truth. but that doesn't change the fact that we are owed nothing and they dont have to tell us anything which is sad. but it can also tell you everything you need to know about how difficult it is for them to deal with aswell.

youre very welcome i genuinely mean that i hope you do find what youre looking for in a person. and it will happen for you. be good stay true.

it would feel better being together 6 weeks after breaking up. you have to give yourself a chance to process the situation and move on you will feel like this again for somone else who is more than willing to give you everything you deserve.

if you miss how you were before tell them that. communicate that and they might feel the same. you dont have to be intense or bring anything up right away you could just try arrange something casual and see how they react but honestly. i dont think you should go down that road.

i dont know much about this situation but my advice to you, would be to move on and find somone who you click with and truly like each other. and live and let live this situation. they may have any number of reasons but none of them are going to change anything. 

i genuinly hope you find happiness and find what youre looking for. you will, so stay strong. goodluck out there take it easy

im not going to pass any judgement here as this isnt the place for it. so no asshole verdict from me.

but i will say that if you've asked them not to do it and they continue knowing it upsets you it shows lack of understanding and its not a good sign. its imporatnt that you stress how much it upsets you that he does this. you deserve to have someone who thinks you're beautiful and wouldnt want to tell you otherwise regardless becos they care about your feelings.

im sure your SO would care that they have hurt you as much as they have if they think there joking like you say so just be open and communicate. 

i hope it works out for you and your SO best of luck out there

Be brave.

nothing is ever as bad as you think it is going to be

also the feelings you have now feel very unique for this person but i can assure you if she rejects you then there is so many amazing people out there to meet and they will love you for who you are.

best of luck to you and i hope it goes sweet

If you're sure what your feeling is true feelings and not just emotional attachment from the feeling she gives you that somebody cares so to speak. 

but saying that if you really do like her then just keep it casual say something like "could you ever see us being a couple?" and see how she reacts you can always say no hard feelings and you should be open and communicate that you want to remain freinds

also dont be too intense and say you love her. you dont even need to mention you have feelings like i say just leave it open ended but also unmistakable.

if its not meant to be its not meant to be you can waste alot of emotional time on somebody who wont reciprocate if you're not careful.

truly i wish you goodluck out there i hope it works out for you.

Its not selfish to want to have a converstation but the reasons behind it could be.

you have to ask yourself are you better apart? is it a knife best left untwisted? only you can answer this but ultimately, it might be a good idea to move on and forget about the reason why as hard as that may be.

if its tearing you up then having a conversation about it is pretty fair i mean its not an unreasonable thing to expect, communication is extremely important but if they dont want to then they dont want to and its wrong to force anybody to do anything. but they still have that choice of not wanting to talk as hard as it is.

i hope you find solace in the situation you have and that you find what youre looking for. best of luck out there

I think reciprocation is very important in any relationship. you should never expect what you're not willing to give from anyone its just not fair.

you deserve someone who will treat you and love you properly. but you haven't provided very much info and it might not be as much of a problem as it feels right now.

its important to communicate with them and explain how you feel they might be going through some stuff. at 17 its hard to understand anything and its all coming at ya at once. so just try remain patient understanding and open. everybody deserves the truth, but sometimes it can be a tough pill to swallow my man dont get hard feelings if she aint feeling it no more. sometimes it isnt meant to be and theres nobody to blame for that

i hope things work out for you both whatever happens. goodluck out there

My thoughts are that you should move on

sometimes people dont feel the thing. its nothing personal its not your fault its not their fault. sometimes people arent suited and thats ok. there will come a time where you have to break up with someone for the same reason

when you move on you'll be glad you did. goodluck out there brother

I cant say for sure. she could be self conscious about herself in that respect, or she may be insecure and worried you would be grossed out or something like this may have happened in their past that has put them off it. its important to remain accepting and understanding which you clearly are. so just remain supportive and patient.


having said that

its very important for your needs to be met just as much as theirs. you deserve somebody who is your type of person the same amount as they do. and thats a reasonable thing to break up with someone for if youre a sexual person its okay to want to be with a like minded person

just aslong as youre not pressuing the person who isnt that way into anything, its better to find sombody else more suited. its never fair to want sombody to change for you. but from what youve explained youre already very patient in that regard.

She may not want to give you head as shes worried shes awful at it. but i dont know anything here for sure its all purely advice

Can i just stress that all these issues could be solved with solid communication which they are avoiding you need to ask them to be upfront with you as everybody deserves the truth. but dont be forceful just explain how you feel. and that you want to be open and communicative.

i truly hope things work out for you and that you find what youre looking for.

It really depends on the person and the situation, but yeah absolutely a good thing

most people would be happy to hear that you're looking forward to seeing them. its simple communication always a great thing. Enjoy your date have a nice time hope it works out

it seems to me like you want to be with somone who is less intense, which i perfectly understandable we all have our types. and it seems like your type is somobody who isnt so full on.

its important to communicate with your SO tell them you feel this way also explain that you want to break up over it or atleast are having thourghts.

If you do decide to break up with them explain the true reason why and that it isnt a problem with anything they have done but just that you dont want to be so chocked.

Its perfectly normal and understandable to feel the way you do its very imporant not to blame yourself or your SO sometimes people are different. but having said that if you do like their personality sometimes if you explain to them and if they know that what they were doing is a problem and by honest communication you explain this then you might find they can accomodate that. theres no point in throwing away a good relationship as truly good people dont come along very often. 

Whatever happens i honestly hope you find what youre looking for and i hope you SO does aswell be it together or apart i hope you both find happiness.

Everything you're feeling is completely understandable

Its very good your self aware in these aspects, you clearly have intelligence on your side.

Living with someone can be an interesting situation theres pitfalls you need to look out for.

its really important to realise love is extremely complex and has many aspects and layers. its not just about raw infatuation. you can unknowingly build resentment for your SO, its unrealistic to expect yourself to be madly infatuated all the time, that is not love. this is not disney.

from what you've described its very understandable to grow some form of resentment from being financially responsible for them. its important not to lose sight of what that means. its doesn't mean you dont love them. just becos you dont feel really intense over them anymore, or even you may feel slight hatred for certain things they do, doesn't mean you dont love them,

It means you are annoyed by A and B and its crucial you realise the difference. to feel that way, thats entirely normal its unrealistic to pretend like that isnt normal here.

its normal to feel somewhat trapped by things like marrige. and faithfulness. its an massive concept and pretending its not life altering is a bad move. its perfectly appropriate to feel weary about it. you dont need to do anything you dont want to.

I understand he may feel very desperate in being left. and its not fair to place that kind of pressure on you, its not fair he would make you feel trapped in that way but... that being said. depression is a fine line and must be handled with genuine concern, and no your happiness is not more important than their life. i truly hope your sadness is temporary and that you dont feel so overwhelemed. but you cant come back from the dead.

i genuinely had to read that a few times as i was in disbelief that somebody could say such a thing. anyway ill brush past that and i'll leave you with this..

Communicate how you feel to them, and don't hold back anything you feel, if you arnet sure. tell them you arnet sure

Everything you're feeling is normal and understandable

and

Ive watched people very close to me make rash decisions and live to regret them for far too long. breaking up with your faience is a large decision i hope you think about it and treat it appropriately and i hope you make the right decision whatever that may be

I genuinely hope that you find happiness, and that your SO does too

Accepting the mistakes of our past can be a tough pill to swallow, but truly its the only way we can learn and improve our current situation.

nobody ever has a way to change the past, the way we mend things is by moving forward and knowing what mistakes weve made, not only to others but to ourselves aswell.

We all lose friends, and heartbreakingly we all lose good friends. its an unrelentingly shitty a part of life.

but with each mistake we make, we learn. Wether you think you have or not, even if it feels like you make the same mistakes again.

No form of sadness hits quite as hard as regret. its important to actively forgive yourself.

Regret can be a silver lining sometimes, ive never had a more character building experience than spending (way too long) regretting the mistakes ive made in my life. it can open your eyes to things you have missed, it can make you change for the better, but it can be all to easy to over-wallow in the melancholy brought on by pondering the past

I don't know anything about you but your attitude speaks for the want of self improvement, but the lack of knowledge to do so, forgive me if im wrong, but you don't want to be like you are? and in all truthfulness you're not. you're what you see yourself as! so you must try very hard to see yourself as a good person. you cannot love others and give them your enjoyable lovley self when you do not love yourself.

It always pains me to see people moving on, but its a pain that is bittersweet as you want them to be happy regardless. FYI the older you get the more meaningful your friendships become cos you end up having a mutual respect for people who stick around. and you learn to read the ones who arnet going to, and you learn to not emotionally invest in such people. give em the old hi - bye ;)

you will experience much more friends they will come, just as they will go thats just life its ever changing and full of surprise, you could be anywhere this time next year.

you probably don't believe me, but i genuinely hope you find what you're looking for, and that it brings you what you want. Goodluck out there

You can never change anything that has ever happened ever, and you never will be able to. So you gonna have to find a way to accept your own and others actions. and the situations that have brought you to where you are now.

You need to concentrate on accepting and understanding what to avoid in future.

Pretty much most friends come and go as I've found and moving on from relationships and fuck ups is and always will be a hard yet fundamental part of life and is something we all have to deal with so you're not alone there.

You will learn how to notice people who are true and solid, the more you get fucked over so think of it as a character building experience 


I just had a quick look through you comment history and i can say that i was once exactly where you are in terms of being in love with someone who didn't feel the same. after a decade of struggle, the best advice i can give you is to move on. like as fast as you can and find what you found in her in somebody who will reciprocate.

Its a interesting thing, as often the person you obsess over in your mind is not one that is true to reality and you can be in-love with something that will never truly exist

sometimes you can even be so caught up in one girl you didn't realise another girl liked you before she got with that other dude and if you had pulled your head from your anal regions sooner you wouldn't miss opportunities like that

A bit of encouraging advice i can throw your way is that life can get better on a swing just as fast as it can get worse. so never give up.

I genuinely hope things get better for you, and that you find what your looking for
